Booth size
Walls
About walls

The back wall is fixed. Side walls fit between the back frame and the open aisle. Click a panel in the 3D view to customise it.

Individual panels

How splitting and merging work

Merge keeps the selected panel's height and artwork, removing the next panel. Custom panels keep their heights when the default wall height changes. Review artwork crops after resizing.

Wall artwork

Pick a panel below or click one in the 3D view.

Artwork requirements

PNG or JPEG · up to 8 MB · max 4,096 px edge / 12 MP. Artwork fills the visible area with a centred crop. Source files are retained in your saved project.

Library

Quick add & your models
Model requirements

Up to 10 MB each · embedded textures · uncompressed GLB 2.0. Models stay in this project. Confirm the physical dimensions after upload.

Click an item in the scene and drag to move it. Drag empty space to orbit; press Escape to cancel a move.

Model dimensions

About orientation

Orientation correction fits the model into the entered dimensions. Confirm width, height and depth after correcting its orientation. No automatic tabletop snapping.

About positions and clashes

Positions refer to each item's floor centre. Boundary and clash checks are approximate and advisory; aisle access needs installer review.
